physical.physical_description: Silk on cotton embroidery, using darning and ladder stitches. The central field is covered with a diaper of diamonds, divided from one another by leafy stems. The diamonds contain floral sprays in a bold style and small leafy sprays set alternately. This field is surrounded by a broad border consisting of a series of ovals, each containing a flowering spray of a bold type. The triangular spaces between these ovals are filled with sprays of leaves and flowers designed on a smaller scale. This border is edged on the inside and the outside by a running scroll design of leaves and flowers.

physical.physical_description:
Embroidered handing made form seven vertical strips of linen, embroidered with silk in shades of cerise, orange, pink, blue, black, green, mauve and yellow. Embroidery techniques include chain and open chain stitches and Bokhara couching with button-holed spots. The embroidered pattern does not match properly across the joins in the material.

Typical Bokhara design of large flower heads enclosed by long, narrow leaves with serrated edges. The hanging is divided into a wide border and a centre panel with a symmetrically arranged pattern of groups of flower heads, the interspaces being filled with leaves and smaller flowers.

physical.physical_description:
Hanging (suzani) of cotton embroidered with silks. Composed of five vertical strips embroidered in cerise, rust, beige, green, yellow, brown and blue. Bukhara couching, chain, broad chain, open chain and crested chain stitches. The border is divided into diamond and triangular-shaped compartments by elongated and serrated leaves. Within the diamonds are large lily flowers alternating with round eight-petalled flowers. Smaller round-head flowers fill the triangles.

The centre is decorated with four large floral sprays which form oval medallions extending inwards from the four corners. The four sprays are all different, with the curving and branching stems bearing two varieties of the lily, one with a carnation and one with a round-headed flower. Arranged over the remainder of the ground are 19 upright plants and leaf forms, all with slender curving stems and small leaves.

Lined with plain cotton and bordered, on the back, with strips of silk and cotton ikat.

physical.physical_description:
Cover of embroidered linen with silks. Made from six vertical strips of linen and embroidered in shades of rust, red, pink, green, brown and orange. Chain stitch and bokhara couching.

The main border is decorated with a series of large round-headed flowers, each decorated with a different pattern, and linked by curving leafy stems bearing smaller flowers. The two subsidiary borders on either side contain continuous scrolling stems bearing leaves and flowers which sit within the curves on alternate sides of the stems.

The centre of the hanging is plain except for two groups of large flowers, encircled by leafy stems, which fill the spandrels of the pointed arch at the top. Lined with plain cotton.

physical.physical_description: Bed cover of embroidered cotton with silks. Orange cotton embroidered with red, blue, green, mauve and other silks. Large floral motif in the centre and at each corner, and with a floral border on three sides and a narrow floral border on the fourth. Lined with printed cottons of three different patterns, each with Indian cones in green, blue, yellow and white on a red ground. Edged with a strip of chiné silk.
